description: This file defines an Android activity named Clipping that demonstrates various clipping techniques on a Canvas, including clipRect and clipPath, with drawing of lines, circles, and text inside different clipped regions.

classes.name: Clipping
classes.description: An Android activity that demonstrates canvas clipping techniques.

classes.name: SampleView
classes.description: A custom View that performs the drawing and clipping operations for the demonstration.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity and sets the content view to an instance of SampleView.

methods.name: drawScene
methods.description: Draws a scene with various shapes and text, applied within current canvas clip region.

methods.name: onDraw
methods.description: Overrides the View's onDraw method to perform multiple clipping and drawing operations to demonstrate different clipping effects.
